original_ai_output.title_zh: 塞内加尔因破坏性洪水推迟开学
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 塞内加尔因近期强降雨和破坏性洪水，宣布全国推迟新学年开学。教育部门称此决定主要出于保障儿童安全与保护的考虑。首都达喀尔部分地区因洪水瘫痪，据报道至少5人死亡。该国数周后将主办2026年夏季青年奥运会。

location.raw_text: Senegal; parts of the capital, Dakar

key_facts.fact: 塞内加尔因近期强降雨和破坏性洪水推迟全国开学
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Senegal has postponed the start of the school year across the country after the recent heavy rain and destructive flooding.

key_facts.fact: 教育部门称推迟决定主要出于保障儿童安全与保护的考虑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The education ministry says the decision was driven 'primarily by the need to ensure the safety and protection' of children.

key_facts.fact: 周五至周一的暴雨影响多个地区并使首都达喀尔部分地区瘫痪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Torrential downpours from Friday through to Monday impacted several regions and paralysed parts of the capital, Dakar.

key_facts.fact: 据报道洪水已造成至少5人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least five people have been reported dead in the flooding

key_facts.fact: 该国数周后将主办2026年夏季青年奥运会
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: which comes weeks before the country is due to host the 2026 Summer Youth Olympics.

uncertainties: 死亡人数为据报道，尚未获得独立确认
